test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

LARGEST : ESTGLAR : : QUALITY : ITYLQUA : : QUICKLY : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic:** The middle letter remains at it place and the 1st three letters and last three letters interchange their positions.

LARGEST : ESTGLAR 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96502202a1250720c1dac6b518029ffc2a70f9d104136829098da11d16be0eda.png] 

and

QUALITY : ITYLQUA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30ee88dc353bbb566ff2a196a4a3eef41e30ce4ae5c28c1f26b90f940268de50.png] 

Similarly,

QUICKLY : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66a81fc0782c5db30d89a4b5f89120c5d9ff8d8f090503195152e29ede395828.png] 

Hence, the code will be '__**KLYCQUI**__' for the given word.
